## Topics

### Coding basics, theory, and patterns

::: {.sortable-checklist}
- [x] apply() family, do.call(), purrr vs loops
- [x] Debugging patterns (tryCatch, stop, warning, message)
- [ ] Code modularization: functions, scripts, package, box, read_chunk()
- [ ] python, Python, PYTHON
- [ ] power and efficiency: compiled code, memory locality, vectorization, parallelization, GPUs...
:::

### Stats and modeling

::: {.sortable-checklist}
- [ ] Bayesian statistics with Stan, cmdstanr, and brms
- [ ] Model validation, sensitivity analysis, and power analyses
- [ ] Overparameterized models, model selection, ensemble modeling, and model averaging
- [ ] Machine learning, LLMs, etc.
- [ ] Model specifics: FRAM, Beverton-Holt, Gaussian Processes, stationarity, GRTS, etc.
:::
